method: walk-forward replay of the production simulation (simulator/src/research/golf_backtest.ts): tuning 2024, holdout 2025-2026; see the file header

production.method: each tour's tuning-season check (2024, before round 1, summed log loss of win, top 10, top 20 and the cut over scales 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2): the measured variances (1) unless another scale beats them with a bootstrap 95% interval below zero

scale.rule: scale 1 (the measured variances) unless the lowest beats it with a bootstrap 95% interval below zero

playoffs.note: the simulated share of runs ending in a playoff (scale 1) against the share of holdout events the feed shows a playoff for (the PGA Tour's feed records playoffs; the LPGA's and DP World Tour's mostly do not)
